# Local model runtime

Hugging Face Transformers.js 3.8.1, distributed under Apache 2.0, with its bundled ONNX Runtime Web files (MIT). Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@huggingface/transformers/v/3.8.1.

Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct weights are downloaded on request from the pinned ONNX Community revision. See https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct.
